message: Request: Write exactly 3 English nurture emails for opted-in electronics hobbyists considering their first general repair toolkit. Each email must stand alone, build a distinct argument, and point to the product page. No invented discounts, deadlines, cart activity, personal knowledge, or guaranteed repair outcomes. Readers have not purchased yet.
